title: Quản trị doanh nghiệp truyền thông

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the fundamental principles and functions of advertising agencies, including organizational structure, client relationship management, human resource management, creativity management, and financial management.
Understand the dynamics of client relationships and how to manage them effectively in the context of advertising agencies.
Understand the role of human capital in advertising agencies and how to manage it effectively.
Understand the nature of creativity and how to manage it within the constraints of time and resources.
Understand the financial operations and performance evaluation of advertising agencies.
Demonstrate the ability to work collaboratively in groups to analyze problems and propose solutions for advertising agencies.
Apply critical thinking skills to analyze business operations and financial performance of advertising agencies.
Effectively present research findings and solutions to problems in a structured and engaging manner.
